ينسجم (form VII)
# يَنْسَجِمُ (yansajimu) /jan.sa.d͡ʒi.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْسَجَمَ (insajama)
# يُنْسَجَمُ (yunsajamu) /jun.sa.d͡ʒa.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْسَجَمَ (insajama)
# يَنْسَجِمَ (yansajima) /jan.sa.d͡ʒi.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَجَمَ (insajama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
